math/decimal#

Exact immutable decimal value.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

Decimal("001.2000").string(); // "1.2"
Decimal("1000").string();     // "1e3"

Description#

Exact immutable decimal value. Construction never trims whitespace and never passes through float. Equivalent spellings share one canonical form:

Arithmetic is exact and written in Okkama on the integer coefficient and the exponent (#191). plus, minus and times keep every digit; divided and rounded keep scale digits after the point, rounded as asked:

let price = Decimal("19.99");
price.plus(Decimal("0.01")).string();   // "2e1"
price.times(Decimal(3)).string();       // "5.997e1"
Decimal(10).divided(by: Decimal(3), scale: 2, rounding: Rounding.half_even).string(); // "3.33"
Decimal("2.675").rounded(scale: 2, rounding: Rounding.half_up).string();            // "2.68"
price.rat();    // 1999/100
price.float();  // 19.99

Lining two exponents up, or a scale far from the exponent, may not shift a coefficient by more than 4096 digits: DecimalLimitExceeded. A far exponent in a document cannot ask for a number of millions of digits.

An exact decimal number: a coefficient times a power of ten, never rounded on its own.

Decimal.times#

Decimal.divided#

divided(by is Decimal, scale is int, rounding is Rounding) is Decimal

The quotient with scale digits after the point: total.divided(by: Decimal(4), scale: 2, rounding: Rounding.half_even). Dividing by zero is DecimalDivisionByZero.

Decimal.rounded#

rounded(scale is int, rounding is Rounding) is Decimal

The value with at most scale digits after the point: total.rounded(scale: 2, rounding: Rounding.half_up). A negative scale rounds to tens, hundreds and so on.

Decimal.rat#

rat() is rat

The exact fraction: Decimal("0.75").rat() is 3/4.

Decimal.float#

float() is float

The nearest float: Decimal("0.1").float() is 0.1. Far beyond the range of float it is an infinity or zero.
